about: Q10 (Miguel 2026-11-17): the 'Best for' modes of a build come from the build's own name/type on the source site, through this one fixed table. The refresh script applies it; Opus re-checks it after every balance patch and monthly. Match order: (a) MW4 Intel page mode is one of our modes -> that mode plus the type list of the build name; (b) the build name is a type key; (c) a keyword is inside the build name; (d) default Versatile (best_for_source 'default', listed in the review report). Mode names are our mode ids in static.json.
